name: 48-border-longhand-top-right
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { margin: 8px 0; line-height: 1.6; font-size: 15px; } .bt { border-top: 5px solid #3366cc; padding-top: 3px; background-color: #eef3ff; } .br { border-right: 7px dashed #cc3366; padding-right: 9px; background-color: #ffeef3; }
html:
border-top 5px solid：上边框参与盒高，内容下压。
border-right 7px dashed：右边框占 7px 宽，行宽应缩窄。
